title: Niagara Falls Day Tour from Toronto with Journey, Skylon, & Boat
includes: Hotel pickup and drop-off anywhere Downtown Toronto
Niagara City Cruises (Admission Included In Price) (May - December)
Seasonal Boat Replacement: Niagara Takes Flight Ride (January - April)
Journey Behind the Falls (Admission Included In Price)
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Collapsible wheelchairs with removable wheels can be accommodated providing the passenger is accompanied by someone who can assist them board and disembark
Please note: Niagara Takes Flight is not accessible to infants or children under 100 cm.
policies: Please note: Voyage To The Falls Boat Tour is seasonal, operating May - November only, replaced with admission to Niagara Takes Flight in the winter. Please phone ahead to check boat availability in season.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
This guided tour combines the region’s top experiences into one seamless day with round-trip transportation from your downtown Toronto hotel. Explore Niagara Falls from above, behind, and right at the base with admission to the Skylon Tower, Journey Behind the Falls, and a Niagara City Cruises boat ride (May–December, replaced by Niagara Takes Flight in winter).

Begin at the Skylon Tower, riding a glass elevator 520 feet up for panoramic views of all three waterfalls and the Niagara River. Next, descend approximately 125 feet at Journey Behind the Falls to explore tunnel-like passageways and stand on observation decks just steps from the cascading water.

Then board the Voyage to the Falls Boat Tour, sailing through the Niagara Gorge and feeling the mist as you get as close as possible to the Falls, with a complimentary poncho provided. Enjoy a narrated drive past landmarks before relaxing on the return drive to your downtown Toronto hotel.
